story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan loved the playground. Today, he wanted to play a new game that he had invented, a sort of 'Super-Speed Obstacle Course.' [emotion:QT/happy] He carefully arranged jump ropes and painted lines on the ground, feeling excited about his amazing design. He watched his friends, Leo and Maya, laugh far away, playing a game that seemed complicated and fun. [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan felt a little worried because he was unsure how to join their group activity.

Leo, who was very observant, saw Ethan standing alone near the swing set. He walked over slowly. “Ethan, what are you building?” Leo asked, pointing to the ropes. Ethan explained that he designed the course because he thought it was the best way to run. [emotion:QT/happy] Leo smiled. “Wow, that looks really challenging! But do you need help setting up the starting point?” Leo asked, suggesting a way to make the beginning safer. [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan hesitated, because he was nervous about making a mistake.

Maya, who was always kind, knelt beside them. “We saw you were working hard on this, Ethan. Do you want to play with us, so that we can help you?” Maya suggested, showing Ethan how to weave a piece of colorful ribbon around a rope. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt a wave of relief. He realized that working with others made the big puzzle easier. They started the course together. Leo suggested that Ethan try the biggest jump first, and [emotion:QT/happy] Maya cheered for him. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan ran quickly across the painted lines, feeling brave. [gesture:clapping] When he finished, they all clapped. [emotion:QT/happy] They laughed because Ethan had been so successful.

[emotion:QT/happy] After the game, Ethan felt genuinely grateful. “Thank you, guys,” Ethan said. “It was fun because you helped me finish my puzzle.” [gesture:nodding-yes] Leo nodded. “We are a great team, Ethan, so that we can build the biggest and best games.”

wrong_answers: A complicated game with his friends.

questions.question: Why did Ethan feel a little worried before joining his friends?
questions.correct_answer: He was unsure how to join their group activity.
wrong_answers: He did not like playing at the playground.
He thought his game was not good enough.

questions.question: What was this story mostly about?
questions.correct_answer: This story was about Ethan who learned to play with friends.
wrong_answers: This story was about Leo who helped Maya.
This story was about building a very big playground.

questions.question: Why did Leo and Maya offer to help Ethan so that he felt better?
questions.correct_answer: They saw him working hard and wanted to play.
wrong_answers: They wanted to play a different game.
They did not like his obstacle course.

questions.question: How did Ethan feel after playing with his friends because they helped him?
questions.correct_answer: He felt genuinely grateful and happy.
wrong_answers: He felt tired and wanted to go home.
He felt angry because they changed his game.
